content: ViewModel's SavedStateHandle can survive configuration changes (rotations) and system-initiated process deaths. Inject SavedStateHandle into ViewModel. You can retrieve StateFlow using getMutableStateFlow() to read/write value directly, which automatically updates the underlying SavedStateHandle without needing to set it manually. Alternatively, for complex UI state mapped to a KotlinX Serialization data class, you can use the 'saved' property delegate: 'var filterState by savedStateHandle.saved { MyState() }', which persists data across process deaths and deserializes automatically upon recreation.
